organising_ideas.name: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Histories and Cultures - VC2CCPAC3
organising_ideas.text: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people belong to the world’s oldest continuous cultures. Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Peoples demonstrate resilience in the maintenance, practice and revitalisation of culture despite the many historic and enduring impacts of colonisation, and they continue to celebrate and share the past, present and future manifestations of their cultures.
organising_ideas.ccp: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Histories and Cultures

content_descriptions.name: VC2HP8M10 - Health and Physical Education
content_descriptions.text: practise and apply leadership, collaboration and group decision-making processes when participating in a range of physical activities
content_descriptions.strand: Movement and Physical Activity – Physical Education

elaborations.name: VC2HP8M10-E01 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: undertaking various roles as a leader or collaborator to support the planning of physical activities for their team or peer group (CA, FMS, GS, LLPA, RE)

elaborations.name: VC2HP8M10-E02 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: adopting roles and responsibilities that support and enhance team cohesion and lead to successful movement outcomes (CA, GS, LLPA, RS)

elaborations.name: VC2HP8M10-E03 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: applying an understanding of verbal, physical and situational cues to identify and respond appropriately to the feelings and motives of others when working in a team or group (AP, CA, GS, LLPA, RE, RS)

elaborations.name: VC2HP8M10-E04 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: reflecting on their role in a team or group and articulating how the actions they initiated in that role led to the achievement of various outcomes (AP, CA, GS, LLPA, RE)

curriculum_content_description.strand_title: Personal, Social and Community Health – Health Education
curriculum_content_description.strand_tag: Personal, Social and Community Health – Health Education

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2HP8P01 - Health and Physical Education
substrand_content_descriptions.text: analyse and reflect on the influence of values and beliefs on the development of identities
substrand_content_descriptions.strand: Personal, Social and Community Health – Health Education

elaborations.name: VC2HP8P01-E01 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: examining the benefits of accepting and appreciating their unique qualities and strengths in supporting their own and others’ wellbeing (MH)

elaborations.name: VC2HP8P01-E02 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: understanding and acknowledging the impacts of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Peoples going through Sorry Business and the protocols that support the communities (MH)

organising_ideas.name: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Histories and Cultures- VC2CCPACP2
organising_ideas.text: The occupation and colonisation of the land now known as Australia by the British, under the now overturned doctrine of terra nullius, were experienced by Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Peoples as an invasion that denied their occupancy of, and connection to, Country and Place.
organising_ideas.ccp: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Histories and Cultures

elaborations.name: VC2HP8P01-E03 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: examining how cultural values and beliefs influence the way young people view themselves, for example Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people and Australians of Asian and other heritage (MH)

organising_ideas.name: Asia and Australia’s Engagement with Asia - VC2CCPASK1
organising_ideas.text: Peoples of the Asia region are diverse in their backgrounds, experiences, traditions, cultures, histories, stories, religions, beliefs, perspectives and languages.
organising_ideas.ccp: Asia and Australia’s Engagement with Asia

organising_ideas.name: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Histories and Cultures - VC2CCPAC1
organising_ideas.text: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander societies are diverse and have distinct cultural expressions, such as language, customs and beliefs. Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Peoples have the right to maintain, control, protect and develop their cultural expressions, while also maintaining the right to control, protect and develop culture as Indigenous Cultural and Intellectual Property.
organising_ideas.ccp: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Histories and Cultures

elaborations.name: VC2HP8P01-E04 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: examining how cultural beliefs about the physical changes experienced during puberty can influence gender, cultural and sexual identities (MH, RS)

elaborations.name: VC2HP8P01-E05 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: investigating strategies to manage the impact of influences on their identities and emotions, and responses to change; for example, seeking social support, practising mindfulness and emotional regulation (MH, RS)

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2HP8P02 - Health and Physical Education
substrand_content_descriptions.text: analyse the impact of changes and transitions, and devise strategies to support themselves and others through these changes
substrand_content_descriptions.strand: Personal, Social and Community Health – Health Education

elaborations.name: VC2HP8P02-E01 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: investigating the changing nature of peer and family relationships and proposing strategies to manage these changes (RS)

elaborations.name: VC2HP8P02-E02 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: accessing and assessing health information and services that support young people to effectively manage changes and transitions as they grow older, including information about sexually transmitted infections, contraception and safe sexual practices (RS, S)

elaborations.name: VC2HP8P02-E03 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: examining how ceremonies of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Peoples involve sharing of cultural knowledge leading to changes in social standing and responsibilities (RS)

organising_ideas.name: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Histories and Cultures - VC2CCPAC1
organising_ideas.text: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander societies are diverse and have distinct cultural expressions, such as language, customs and beliefs. Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Peoples have the right to maintain, control, protect and develop their cultural expressions, while also maintaining the right to control, protect and develop culture as Indigenous Cultural and Intellectual Property.
organising_ideas.ccp: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Histories and Cultures

elaborations.name: VC2HP8P02-E04 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: examining the notion of code switching; that is, how Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Peoples live across multiple cultures, and how these transitions can affect a sense of belonging to culture, family and peer groups (MH, RS)

organising_ideas.name: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Histories and Cultures - VC2CCPAP2
organising_ideas.text: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Peoples have sophisticated political, economic and social organisation systems, which include but are not limited to family and kinship structures, laws, traditions, customs, land tenure systems and protocols for strong governance and authority.
organising_ideas.ccp: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Histories and Cultures

elaborations.name: VC2HP8P02-E05 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: evaluating and practising coping, communication and problem-solving skills to manage changes and emotions associated with puberty, getting older and transitioning to new environments (such as secondary school) (MH, RS)

elaborations.name: VC2HP8P02-E06 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: examining the impact of physical, social and emotional changes that occur during periods of transition (most of which are beyond an individual’s control) and discussing the value of positive peer environments in supporting belonging and wellbeing (MH, RS)

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2HP8P03 - Health and Physical Education
substrand_content_descriptions.text: examine how roles, decision-making, and levels of power, coercion and control within relationships can be influenced by gender stereotypes
substrand_content_descriptions.strand: Personal, Social and Community Health – Health Education

elaborations.name: VC2HP8P03-E01 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: exploring scenarios in texts that demonstrate how gender inequality can arise from intergenerational patterns of inequity and unequal power in relationships (RS)

elaborations.name: VC2HP8P03-E02 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: examining how gender roles and stereotypes can influence beliefs and decisions about self, friendships, sexual relationships, sexual behaviour, contraceptive use, substance use and future life plans (AD, MH, RS, S)

elaborations.name: VC2HP8P03-E03 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: identifying those positive character attributes and strengths that are valued regardless of gender (MH, RS)

elaborations.name: VC2HP8P03-E04 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: investigating strategies that have been successful in challenging harmful or limiting stereotypes, attitudes or practices (RS)

elaborations.name: VC2HP8P03-E05 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: exploring texts that demonstrate the impact of stigmatising language, such as negative labels, stereotypes and judgement, on the health and wellbeing of affected people (MH, RS)

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2HP8P04 - Health and Physical Education
substrand_content_descriptions.text: examine the roles of respect, empathy, power and coercion in developing respectful relationships
substrand_content_descriptions.strand: Personal, Social and Community Health – Health Education

elaborations.name: VC2HP8P04-E01 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: analysing how their behaviours, actions and responses to situations can change depending on whether they are by themselves, with friends or with family (RS)

elaborations.name: VC2HP8P04-E02 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: recognising the impact bullying and harassment can have on relationships, including online relationships (MH, RS)

elaborations.name: VC2HP8P04-E03 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: showing respect for cultural norms and sensitivities when building relationships with people from different cultural backgrounds (RS)

elaborations.name: VC2HP8P04-E04 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: proposing strategies for addressing racism towards people of different cultural backgrounds, including Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Peoples, and examining the role of upstanders in promoting respectful interactions and challenging disrespect and discrimination (MH, RS)

organising_ideas.name: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Histories and Cultures - VC2CCPAC3
organising_ideas.text: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people belong to the world’s oldest continuous cultures. Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Peoples demonstrate resilience in the maintenance, practice and revitalisation of culture despite the many historic and enduring impacts of colonisation, and they continue to celebrate and share the past, present and future manifestations of their cultures.
organising_ideas.ccp: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Histories and Cultures

elaborations.name: VC2HP8P04-E05 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: examining what constitutes disrespectful, harmful or violent behaviour within peer, family and intimate relationships (RS, S)

elaborations.name: VC2HP8P04-E06 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: understanding and applying online and social protocols to enhance relationships with others and protect their own wellbeing, including recognising and responding to inappropriate online content (MH, RS, S)

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2HP8P05 - Health and Physical Education
substrand_content_descriptions.text: investigate strategies that influence how communities value diversity and propose actions they can take to promote inclusion in their communities
substrand_content_descriptions.strand: Personal, Social and Community Health – Health Education

elaborations.name: VC2HP8P05-E01 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: investigating how respecting diversity and challenging racism, sexism, ableism and homophobia influence individual and community health and wellbeing (MH, RS, S)

elaborations.name: VC2HP8P05-E02 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: examining values and beliefs about cultural and social issues such as gender, race, violence, sexuality, body image and ability, and examining how resisting stereotypes can empower individuals to be themselves (MH, RS)

elaborations.name: VC2HP8P05-E03 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: developing strategies to challenge prejudicial views of gender, race, violence, sexual diversity, gender diversity, body image and ability to contribute to inclusive communities (RS)

elaborations.name: VC2HP8P05-E04 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: researching how norms, stereotypes and prejudice are challenged in local, national and global contexts (RS)

elaborations.name: VC2HP8P05-E05 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: investigating events and strategies that value the contributions of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Peoples, such as Indigenous rounds in sporting codes and NAIDOC Week (MH, RS)

organising_ideas.name: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Histories and Cultures - VC2CCPAP3
organising_ideas.text: The significant and ongoing contributions of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Peoples and their histories and cultures are acknowledged locally, nationally and globally.
organising_ideas.ccp: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Histories and Cultures

elaborations.name: VC2HP8P05-E06 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: identifying examples of beliefs and cultural practices within, between and across cultural groups, including cultural groups from the Asian region, and describing how they have changed or remained the same over time (MH, RS)

organising_ideas.name: Asia and Australia’s Engagement with Asia - VC2CCPASK1
organising_ideas.text: Peoples of the Asia region are diverse in their backgrounds, experiences, traditions, cultures, histories, stories, religions, beliefs, perspectives and languages.
organising_ideas.ccp: Asia and Australia’s Engagement with Asia

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2HP8P06 - Health and Physical Education
substrand_content_descriptions.text: analyse factors that influence emotional responses and devise strategies to self-manage emotions
substrand_content_descriptions.strand: Personal, Social and Community Health – Health Education

elaborations.name: VC2HP8P06-E01 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: investigating personal, social and cultural factors that influence the way individuals respond emotionally to different situations and determining the impact these responses could have on others (MH, RS)

elaborations.name: VC2HP8P06-E02 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: exploring different viewpoints, practising being empathetic and considering alternative ways to respond in a variety of situations, taking into account how these responses may affect others (MH, RS)

elaborations.name: VC2HP8P06-E03 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: recognising and interpreting emotional responses to stressful situations and proposing strategies to ensure those responses don’t have a negative impact on their relationships with others (MH, RS)

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2HP8P07 - Health and Physical Education
substrand_content_descriptions.text: explain and apply skills and strategies to communicate assertively and respectfully when seeking, giving or denying consent across multiple settings (including online and offline)
substrand_content_descriptions.strand: Personal, Social and Community Health – Health Education

elaborations.name: VC2HP8P07-E01 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: exploring and refining skills and strategies needed to communicate assertively and respectfully in relationships (RS, S)

elaborations.name: VC2HP8P07-E02 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: understanding and applying online protocols to enhance relationships with others (MH, RS, S)

elaborations.name: VC2HP8P07-E03 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: protecting their own physical and emotional wellbeing, including recognising and responding to online content that may be harmful to themselves or others (such as grooming or image-based abuse) and respectfully communicating needs and concerns to a trusted adult (MH, RS, S)

elaborations.name: VC2HP8P07-E04 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: examining the nature of consent in different types of relationships, and proposing and practising strategies for seeking, giving and denying consent respectfully (RS, S)

elaborations.name: VC2HP8P07-E05 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: rehearsing decision-making strategies they could use when giving or denying consent in different situations; for example, identifying the problem, planning to solve the problem and putting the solution into action (RS, S)

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2HP8P08 - Health and Physical Education
substrand_content_descriptions.text: refine protective behaviours and evaluate community resources to seek help for themselves and others (including basic first aid and CPR)
substrand_content_descriptions.strand: Personal, Social and Community Health – Health Education

elaborations.name: VC2HP8P08-E01 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: exploring different strategies they can use, and resources or help sites they can access or refer others to, if they are experiencing symptoms of anxiety or depression (MH, S)

elaborations.name: VC2HP8P08-E02 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: examining scenarios to highlight how emotions, dispositions, social supports, and gender and cultural norms can affect a person’s willingness to seek help (MH, RS)

elaborations.name: VC2HP8P08-E03 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: exploring strategies for dealing with online abuse and bullying when there is an imbalance of power, such as grooming, image-based abuse or negative social interactions, and reporting the situation to appropriate authorities, trusted adults and through online tools (RS, S)

elaborations.name: VC2HP8P08-E04 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: analysing how upstanders play a role in ensuring online spaces are positive and safe, and examining how support services such as Kids Helpline and the eSafety Commissioner can provide support for young people who feel unsafe, bullied or abused online (MH, RS, S)

elaborations.name: VC2HP8P08-E05 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: exploring help-seeking scenarios young people may encounter and sharing strategies for dealing with each situation, including situations linked to substance use (such as alcohol, cigarettes, e-cigarettes, cannabis or inhalants), mental health issues, safety and risk-taking, and sexual health (AD, MH, RS, S)

elaborations.name: VC2HP8P08-E06 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: exploring basic first-aid principles and practising strategies to assist others in an emergency situation, such as DRSABCD and RICER (S)

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2HP8P09 - Health and Physical Education
substrand_content_descriptions.text: investigate how media and influential people in the community impact attitudes, beliefs, decisions and behaviours in relation to health, safety, relationships and wellbeing
substrand_content_descriptions.strand: Personal, Social and Community Health – Health Education

elaborations.name: VC2HP8P09-E01 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: analysing the credibility, validity and relevance of health messages conveyed by different sources (including news sites, bloggers, influencers and social media advertising) and applying credible information to health-related decisions (AD, FN, HBPA, MH, RS, S)

elaborations.name: VC2HP8P09-E02 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: investigating how messages related to food are portrayed in the media and how this may impact decision-making in relation to health and wellbeing (FN)

elaborations.name: VC2HP8P09-E03 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: exploring and evaluating the accessibility and reliability of health information in the media that targets young people in relation to their health, wellbeing, body, sexuality, relationships and other health issues (AD, FN, HBPA, MH, RS, S)

elaborations.name: VC2HP8P09-E04 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: investigating community health campaigns targeting young people (including those targeting Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Peoples) and developing a school or community action plan to raise awareness and support for a chosen campaign (AD, FN, HBPA, MH, RS, S)

organising_ideas.name: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Histories and Cultures - VC2CCPAC3
organising_ideas.text: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people belong to the world’s oldest continuous cultures. Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Peoples demonstrate resilience in the maintenance, practice and revitalisation of culture despite the many historic and enduring impacts of colonisation, and they continue to celebrate and share the past, present and future manifestations of their cultures.
organising_ideas.ccp: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Histories and Cultures

elaborations.name: VC2HP8P09-E05 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: analysing how messages related to bodies and appearance and sexual relationships are portrayed in different forms of media and how they may influence the way people feel about themselves and the way they act within relationships (MH, RS)

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2HP8P10 - Health and Physical Education
substrand_content_descriptions.text: plan and implement strategies, using health resources, to enhance their own and others’ health, safety, relationships and wellbeing
substrand_content_descriptions.strand: Personal, Social and Community Health – Health Education

elaborations.name: VC2HP8P10-E01 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: researching health information and messaging to recognise credible sources of information, for example government organisations, the Royal Children’s Hospital and Beyond Blue (AD, FN, HBPA, MH, RS, S)

elaborations.name: VC2HP8P10-E02 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: investigating the recommendations made in the Australian Guide to Healthy Eating, the nutritional value of food, value for money and sustainability, and producing a guide to help students make choices when buying food from the school canteen and preparing snack and lunch options (FN)

elaborations.name: VC2HP8P10-E03 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: researching community messages and programs designed to promote safety, health and wellbeing in the community, such as road safety, safe use of public transport, water safety, food choices, education about e-cigarettes and gaming, and taking action to promote increased awareness of these programs in their community (AD, FN, HBPA, MH, RS, S)

elaborations.name: VC2HP8P10-E04 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: examining how different cultures value the contribution of the mind–body–spirit connection to health and wellbeing, for example Dadirri (the Aboriginal meditative practice of deep listening developed and shared by the Aboriginal Peoples of the Daly River region) and yoga and meditation practices from the Asia region (HBPA, MH)

organising_ideas.name: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Histories and Cultures - VC2CCPAC1
organising_ideas.text: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander societies are diverse and have distinct cultural expressions, such as language, customs and beliefs. Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Peoples have the right to maintain, control, protect and develop their cultural expressions, while also maintaining the right to control, protect and develop culture as Indigenous Cultural and Intellectual Property.
organising_ideas.ccp: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Histories and Cultures

organising_ideas.name: Asia and Australia’s Engagement with Asia - VC2CCPASK1
organising_ideas.text: Peoples of the Asia region are diverse in their backgrounds, experiences, traditions, cultures, histories, stories, religions, beliefs, perspectives and languages.
organising_ideas.ccp: Asia and Australia’s Engagement with Asia

elaborations.name: VC2HP8P10-E05 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: investigating preventive health strategies relevant to young people, and designing and implementing health promotion activities that raise awareness of these strategies (AD, FN, HBPA, MH, RS, S)

elaborations.name: VC2HP8P10-E06 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: investigating different approaches and developing personal plans for promoting their own positive mental health and wellbeing, such as mindfulness, relaxation techniques, using ‘do not disturb’ mode or turning off notifications on online devices, regular physical activity and increasing vegetable intake (FN, HBPA, MH)

curriculum_content_description.strand_title: Movement and Physical Activity – Physical Education
curriculum_content_description.strand_tag: Movement and Physical Activity – Physical Education

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2HP8M01 - Health and Physical Education
substrand_content_descriptions.text: refine and transfer movement skills in a variety of movement situations, including indoor, outdoor and aquatic settings
substrand_content_descriptions.strand: Movement and Physical Activity – Physical Education

elaborations.name: VC2HP8M01-E01 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: analysing their own and/or others’ performance using digital tools and implementing feedback to enhance performance of movement skills, including fundamental movement skills if required (CA, FMS, GS, LLPA, RE)

elaborations.name: VC2HP8M01-E02 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: transferring fielding skills from similar games when playing traditional and non-traditional sports and activities (AP, FMS, GS, LLPA)

elaborations.name: VC2HP8M01-E03 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: refining passing and receiving skills in a game involving increased defensive pressure (AP, FMS, GS)

elaborations.name: VC2HP8M01-E04 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: using feedback from teammates in a game to know when to travel, mark or intercept to achieve and retain possession (FMS, GS)

elaborations.name: VC2HP8M01-E05 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: refining a range of swimming strokes using feedback from a teacher, peer or video resources (FMS, LLPA, S)

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2HP8M02 - Health and Physical Education
substrand_content_descriptions.text: design and demonstrate how movement strategies can be manipulated to improve movement outcomes
substrand_content_descriptions.strand: Movement and Physical Activity – Physical Education

elaborations.name: VC2HP8M02-E01 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: developing and implementing appropriate strategies for selected movement scenarios (CA, GS, LLPA)

elaborations.name: VC2HP8M02-E02 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: selecting strategies that have been successful previously and applying the most appropriate ones when solving new movement challenges (AP, CA, GS, LLPA)

elaborations.name: VC2HP8M02-E03 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: designing a new attacking and/or defensive strategy during minor or modified games (AP, GS)

elaborations.name: VC2HP8M02-E04 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: predicting the effectiveness of changes in tactics or strategies on scoring opportunities (AP, GS)

elaborations.name: VC2HP8M02-E05 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: examining and demonstrating the similarities of strategies used in different physical activities and how they can be transferred to new movement situations (AP, CA, GS, LLPA)

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2HP8M03 - Health and Physical Education
substrand_content_descriptions.text: demonstrate and explain how movement concepts related to effort, space, time, objects and people can be manipulated to improve movement outcomes
substrand_content_descriptions.strand: Movement and Physical Activity – Physical Education

elaborations.name: VC2HP8M03-E01 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: performing a range of movements and analysing technique based on understanding of effort in relation to take-off, body position and landing (FMS, RE)

elaborations.name: VC2HP8M03-E02 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: demonstrating an understanding of how to adjust the angle of release of an object and how this will affect the height and distance of flight (FMS, GS)

elaborations.name: VC2HP8M03-E03 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: designing and refining performances to demonstrate how to manipulate space and relationships between players in the space to achieve successful movement outcomes (AP, FMS, GS)

elaborations.name: VC2HP8M03-E04 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: adjusting the timing of movement when performing skills in new movement situations such as striking a pitched ball rather than a stationary ball, or timing of rhythmic movement to music (AP, FMS, GS, RE)

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2HP8M04 - Health and Physical Education
substrand_content_descriptions.text: adapt and perform movement sequences in a variety of contexts, demonstrating how the movement elements of time, effort, space, people and objects can enhance performance
substrand_content_descriptions.strand: Movement and Physical Activity – Physical Education

elaborations.name: VC2HP8M04-E01 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: using feedback from others to refine the composition of a group movement sequence in response to music or other stimuli (FMS, RE)

elaborations.name: VC2HP8M04-E02 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: performing rhythmic movement sequences that demonstrate variations in flow of movements, use of space and relationships to other performers (FMS, RE)

elaborations.name: VC2HP8M04-E03 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: creating and performing different movement sequences requiring static and dynamic balance, demonstrating transition between the bases of support and flow of movements (FMS, RE)

elaborations.name: VC2HP8M04-E04 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: performing movement sequences to safely and efficiently travel around, over, up, under and through obstacles in an outdoor environment or built obstacles (CA, FMS, LLPA, S)

elaborations.name: VC2HP8M04-E05 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: using feedback from a peer coach to adapt movement sequences to create, use and defend space in invasion, net/court, striking and fielding, and target games (FMS, GS)

elaborations.name: VC2HP8M04-E06 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: adapt and combine previously learned skills to perform more complex athletic skills such as those for triple jump, high jump and javelin, demonstrating the elements of movement (FMS, GS)

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2HP8M05 - Health and Physical Education
substrand_content_descriptions.text: participate in physical activities designed to improve fitness to investigate the impact of regular participation on health and wellbeing
substrand_content_descriptions.strand: Movement and Physical Activity – Physical Education

elaborations.name: VC2HP8M05-E01 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: using digital tools to design and monitor personal physical activity programs that support regular participation and meet their individual health, wellbeing and fitness goals (HBPA, LLPA)

field_grouped_levels_per_subject.name: Health and Physical Education - Levels 9 and 10 (Curriculum)

curriculum_band_description.body:
In Levels 9 and 10, the curriculum builds on each student’s prior learning. During this time, students refine their understanding of how they can contribute to individual and community health and wellbeing.

Students explore practical and creative actions that promote their own and others’ health and wellbeing and that of their wider community, such as designing strategies to promote safe practices that will contribute to the health and wellbeing of young people. Practical learning experiences at these levels support students to plan, implement, monitor and evaluate personal habits to enhance their wellbeing.

Students explore how societal attitudes and values can reinforce stereotypes and role expectations. They investigate how these can impact young people’s decision-making in relation to actions they take to promote their own and others’ health, healthcare options, help-seeking strategies and physical activity participation.

Students investigate a range of health issues relevant to young people, including mental health, sexual health, healthy eating, personal and relationship safety, body image, and behaviours associated with substance use. As they do so, students further refine their help-seeking strategies, assertive behaviours, conflict resolution and negotiation.

Students have opportunities to explore the nature and benefits of respectful relationships. They further develop skills to manage their relationships as these change over time. They have opportunities to explore empathy, ethical decision-making, respect and consent, and analyse the roles of these in establishing and maintaining respectful relationships.

Students practise and refine more specialised movement skills and complex movement strategies and concepts in different movement environments. They apply movement concepts and strategies to evaluate and refine their own and others’ movement performances.

Students have frequent opportunities to participate in physical activities, including in outdoor environments and aquatic settings, to value the importance of active recreation as a way of enhancing their health and wellbeing throughout their lives.

Students further investigate techniques to assess the quality of movement performances. They adapt and improvise their movements to respond to different movement situations, stimuli and challenges. Students refine and consolidate their leadership, teamwork and collaborative skills through participation in a range of physical activities.

curriculum_achievement_standard.body:
By the end of Level 10, students propose and evaluate personal strategies to manage their identities and responses to change and transitions. They evaluate how attitudes and beliefs about equality, respect, diversity and inclusion influence the nature and quality of relationships. They evaluate personal strategies to manage emotional responses to different situations and reflect on the impact of their ability to manage these responses on health and wellbeing. Students propose and evaluate strategies to manage online and offline situations where their own or others’ health, safety, relationships or wellbeing may be negatively impacted. They synthesise health information from credible sources to propose and justify strategies that can enhance their own, others’ and the community’s health, safety, relationships and wellbeing.

Students evaluate and refine their own and others’ movement skills and performances, and apply movement concepts in challenging or unfamiliar situations. They adapt and transfer movement skills and strategies to unfamiliar situations and evaluate the effectiveness to achieve successful outcomes. They apply criteria to evaluate and refine their own and others’ movement performances. Students critique the effectiveness of strategies designed to enhance health, fitness and wellbeing. They propose and evaluate community-based physical activity interventions designed to improve the health and wellbeing of themselves and others. Students apply and evaluate leadership approaches, collaboration strategies and ethical behaviours across a range of movement contexts.

elaborations.elaboration_text: evaluating strategies and actions to increase safety, such as road safety and water safety programs, and planning to promote these in the school and community (S)

elaborations.name: VC2HP10P09-E04 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: investigating proactive community strategies for promoting better access and improved health outcomes for different groups in the community, including Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Peoples, people living in remote areas and people with disabilities, for example remote area dialysis buses and community-based treatment options (AD, FN, HBPA, MH, RS, S)

organising_ideas.name: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Histories and Cultures - VC2CCPAC3
organising_ideas.text: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people belong to the world’s oldest continuous cultures. Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Peoples demonstrate resilience in the maintenance, practice and revitalisation of culture despite the many historic and enduring impacts of colonisation, and they continue to celebrate and share the past, present and future manifestations of their cultures.
organising_ideas.ccp: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Histories and Cultures

elaborations.name: VC2HP10P09-E05 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: discussing how the portrayal of sexual relationships in TV shows, advertisements, movies, popular music and online content (such as pornography) may influence people’s beliefs about respectful, safe and consensual relationships (RS, S)

elaborations.name: VC2HP10P09-E06 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: investigating how the use of gambling advertisements (‘gamble responsibly’ taglines) on TV and online accessibility to gambling may influence young people’s attitudes and behaviours around gambling, and proposing strategies to educate young people (MH, S)

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2HP10P10 - Health and Physical Education
substrand_content_descriptions.text: plan, justify and critique strategies to enhance their own, others’ and community’s health, safety, relationships and wellbeing
substrand_content_descriptions.strand: Personal, Social and Community Health – Health Education

elaborations.name: VC2HP10P10-E01 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: investigating community-action initiatives young people have led that have had a positive influence on the health and wellbeing of their communities and instigating similar initiatives that could have a positive impact on the health and wellbeing of their community (AD, FN, HBPA, MH, RS, S)

elaborations.name: VC2HP10P10-E02 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: investigating how cultural rights of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Peoples include maintaining traditional diets, and explaining how these have proven health and wellbeing benefits (FN, RS)

organising_ideas.name: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Histories and Cultures - VC2CCPAC1
organising_ideas.text: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander societies are diverse and have distinct cultural expressions, such as language, customs and beliefs. Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Peoples have the right to maintain, control, protect and develop their cultural expressions, while also maintaining the right to control, protect and develop culture as Indigenous Cultural and Intellectual Property.
organising_ideas.ccp: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Histories and Cultures

elaborations.name: VC2HP10P10-E03 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: analysing the influence social, cultural and economic factors may have on health behaviours and help-seeking strategies, such as factors associated with menstrual health, gender diversity, sexual health and mental illness (MH, RS)

elaborations.name: VC2HP10P10-E04 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: proposing constructive, healthy and manageable actions when using digital tools and digital media to promote respect, inclusion and the wellbeing of others, such as researching what to do if they, or someone they know, is being targeted online (MH, S)

elaborations.name: VC2HP10P10-E05 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: investigating community-based initiatives to keep young people safe, such as initiatives targeting road safety, e-cigarettes, alcohol and drug use and gambling, and devising strategies to promote safe practices that will contribute to the health and wellbeing of young people in their communities, such as at school and sporting clubs (AD, MH, S)

elaborations.name: VC2HP10P10-E06 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: designing and evaluating strategies that enhance their own and others’ mental health and wellbeing, such as regular physical activity, positive self-talk, consistent sleep habits, mindfulness and social connection (HBPA, MH)

curriculum_content_description.strand_title: Movement and Physical Activity – Physical Education
curriculum_content_description.strand_tag: Movement and Physical Activity – Physical Education

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2HP10M01 - Health and Physical Education
substrand_content_descriptions.text: analyse, apply and adapt their own and others’ movement skills in a range of challenging movement situations to enhance performance in indoor, outdoor and aquatic settings
substrand_content_descriptions.strand: Movement and Physical Activity – Physical Education

elaborations.name: VC2HP10M01-E01 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: using knowledge of results feedback to support another student in refining a skill to perform with greater accuracy and control (CA, GS)

elaborations.name: VC2HP10M01-E02 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: using digital tools to record their own and others’ performance and providing feedback on timing of movement in relation to teammates, opposition players, movement of the ball or other external stimuli (GS)

elaborations.name: VC2HP10M01-E03 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: adapting and responding to changes in equipment that increase the complexity of a movement task or performance (CA, GS, RE)

elaborations.name: VC2HP10M01-E04 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: analysing their own or others’ performances, such as at a swimming, cross-country or athletics carnival, and proposing strategies for refining technique to improve performance (CA, GS, LLPA)

elaborations.name: VC2HP10M01-E05 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: transferring and adapting skills learned in one movement situation to different situations, such as in outdoor environments or aquatic settings (CA, GS, LLPA, RE)

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2HP10M02 - Health and Physical Education
substrand_content_descriptions.text: create and refine movement strategies to achieve successful outcomes across a range of challenging movement situations
substrand_content_descriptions.strand: Movement and Physical Activity – Physical Education

elaborations.name: VC2HP10M02-E01 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: reviewing, proposing and implementing alternative responses to movement situations based on the outcome of previous performances (CA, GS, LLPA, RE)

elaborations.name: VC2HP10M02-E02 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: performing and refining specialised movement skills in situations where the rules or conditions have been modified to vary complexity (CA, GS)

elaborations.name: VC2HP10M02-E03 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: adapting and refining movement strategies to enhance movement outcomes when using different types of equipment (CA, GS, LLPA, RE)

elaborations.name: VC2HP10M02-E04 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: evaluating the effectiveness of a range of strategies in game situations using a personally developed set of criteria and suggesting how to adapt to improve performance (GS)

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2HP10M03 - Health and Physical Education
substrand_content_descriptions.text: apply movement concepts in new or challenging movement situations and analyse the impact they have on movement outcomes
substrand_content_descriptions.strand: Movement and Physical Activity – Physical Education

elaborations.name: VC2HP10M03-E01 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: experimenting with the manipulation of force and speed applied to an object to examine the difference created in movement paths, such as top-spin forehands and outswing bowling (AP, GS)

elaborations.name: VC2HP10M03-E02 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: analysing a range of ways the body can absorb force and evaluating which techniques and equipment are most effective in preventing potential injury across a range of movement tasks (CA, GS, RE, S)

elaborations.name: VC2HP10M03-E03 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: analysing and describing how individual or team performance has improved through modifications to the use of space and time (AP, CA, GS)

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2HP10M04 - Health and Physical Education
substrand_content_descriptions.text: evaluate their own and others’ movement compositions and provide and apply feedback to enhance performance, including the impact of the movement elements of time, effort, space, people and objects
substrand_content_descriptions.strand: Movement and Physical Activity – Physical Education

elaborations.name: VC2HP10M04-E01 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: providing constructive feedback on their own and others’ group performance of a movement sequence (RE)

elaborations.name: VC2HP10M04-E02 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: creating and evaluating a group performance that demonstrates synchronous and individual movements (RE)

elaborations.name: VC2HP10M04-E03 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: using digital tools to record others’ performance, and providing feedback on synchronicity and timing of movements in relation to other people, objects or external stimuli (GS, RE)

elaborations.name: VC2HP10M04-E04 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: providing constructive feedback on their own and others’ performance by using movement-analysis software to break down a skill or sequence (CA, GS, RE)

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2HP10M05 - Health and Physical Education
substrand_content_descriptions.text: participate in and evaluate physical activities designed to enhance health, fitness and wellbeing
substrand_content_descriptions.strand: Movement and Physical Activity – Physical Education

elaborations.name: VC2HP10M05-E01 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: performing a range of activities designed to improve fitness and analysing how the activities improve individual fitness components (GS, HBPA, LLPA)

elaborations.name: VC2HP10M05-E02 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: proposing realistic physical activity goals, and designing, implementing and evaluating a personalised program to incorporate regular physical activity into their weekly routines (HBPA)

elaborations.name: VC2HP10M05-E03 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: designing and modelling different warm-up and cool-down routines for the class and discussing their importance for reducing the chance of injuries or soreness after activity (GS, HBPA, LLPA, S)

elaborations.name: VC2HP10M05-E04 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: investigating the cognitive and mental health benefits of physical activity and proposing strategies to support themselves or others to maintain engagement in physical activity to overcome barriers (HBPA, LLPA, MH)

elaborations.name: VC2HP10M05-E05 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: evaluating the signs of overtraining and engagement in physical activity at levels that might have a negative impact on mental health and wellbeing (HBPA, MH, S)

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2HP10M06 - Health and Physical Education
substrand_content_descriptions.text: participate in physical activities that promote health, safety and social outcomes in outdoor environments and aquatic settings to design and evaluate participation strategies for themselves and others
substrand_content_descriptions.strand: Movement and Physical Activity – Physical Education

elaborations.name: VC2HP10M06-E01 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: creating and evaluating proposals to promote the use of outdoor environments within the local community for physical activity (CA, HBPA, LLPA)

organising_ideas.name: Sustainability - VC2CCPSRD1
organising_ideas.text: Responsibly designed products and services aim to minimise the human impact on the environment and restore the quality, ecological integrity and diversity of economic, social, environmental and cultural systems.
organising_ideas.ccp: Sustainability

elaborations.name: VC2HP10M06-E02 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: designing and evaluating a strategy to involve family, friends and members of the community in celebrations based around culturally significant physical activities to promote a sense of connection with and belonging to the community (CA, HBPA, LLPA, MH)

elaborations.name: VC2HP10M06-E03 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: investigating community-based campaigns to promote physical activity participation and evaluating key elements of success that could be replicated in a school-based campaign (HBPA)

elaborations.name: VC2HP10M06-E04 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: investigating local outdoor environments and community spaces where individuals and groups can connect and participate in physical and social activities (CA, HBPA, LLPA, MH)

elaborations.name: VC2HP10M06-E05 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: evaluating the role of access to outdoor and aquatic environments in achieving health and social outcomes (CA, HBPA, LLPA, MH, S)

organising_ideas.name: Sustainability - VC2CCPSFT2
organising_ideas.text: Sustainable futures thinking creates desirable futures that value local, community, national and global equity and fairness across generations and into the future.
organising_ideas.ccp: Sustainability

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2HP10M07 - Health and Physical Education
substrand_content_descriptions.text: design, implement and evaluate personalised plans for improving or maintaining their own or others’ physical activity levels to achieve health-related fitness, health and wellbeing outcomes
substrand_content_descriptions.strand: Movement and Physical Activity – Physical Education

elaborations.name: VC2HP10M07-E01 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: using digital tools to design, implement, monitor and evaluate a personal fitness plan that includes a timeframe, goals and a variety of specific activities that meet the needs of different people (HBPA, LLPA)

elaborations.name: VC2HP10M07-E02 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: justifying the selection of physical activities included in a personalised plan linked to physical activity goals and wellbeing outcomes they wish to improve or maintain (HBPA, LLPA)

elaborations.name: VC2HP10M07-E03 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: proposing and evaluating community-based physical activities that could be included in physical activity plans and evaluating the accessibility of these activities to promote their own and others’ health and wellbeing (HBPA, LLPA)

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2HP10M08 - Health and Physical Education
substrand_content_descriptions.text: transfer and adapt skills and strategies from previous experiences to create successful outcomes in unfamiliar movement situations
substrand_content_descriptions.strand: Movement and Physical Activity – Physical Education

elaborations.name: VC2HP10M08-E01 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: drawing parallels between successful movement strategies in one sporting situation and how similar strategies could be used effectively in a different sport (CA, GS, RE)

elaborations.name: VC2HP10M08-E02 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: applying solutions to movement challenges based on past experiences when participating in outdoor or nature-based activities, such as rock climbing, bushwalking, abseiling, canoeing or kayaking (CA, LLPA)

elaborations.name: VC2HP10M08-E03 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: reflecting on the effectiveness of movement solutions, suggesting improvements that can be made and proposing how the solution can be transferred to other movement situations (CA, GS, RE)

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2HP10M09 - Health and Physical Education
substrand_content_descriptions.text: demonstrate fair play and reflect on how ethical behaviour can influence physical activity outcomes for individuals and groups
substrand_content_descriptions.strand: Movement and Physical Activity – Physical Education

elaborations.name: VC2HP10M09-E01 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: evaluating how equitable participation in group activities can influence outcomes in physical activity (CA, GS, LLPA, RS)

elaborations.name: VC2HP10M09-E02 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: analysing how Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander athletes have been treated in different sports and evaluating the impact that treatment may have on the participation of young Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people in sport and physical activity (GS, MH, RS)

organising_ideas.name: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Histories and Cultures - VC2CCPAP3
organising_ideas.text: The significant and ongoing contributions of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Peoples and their histories and cultures are acknowledged locally, nationally and globally.
organising_ideas.ccp: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Histories and Cultures

elaborations.name: VC2HP10M09-E03 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: participating in competitions where players rather than an independent official are responsible for applying the rules (GS, RS)

elaborations.name: VC2HP10M09-E04 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: interpreting the role organisations play in fairness and ethical behaviour in sport, including organisations such as the Australian Sports Anti-Doping Authority, sporting tribunals, the Australian Human Rights Commission and the Court of Arbitration for Sport (GS, S)

elaborations.name: VC2HP10M09-E05 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: evaluating ethical behaviours and leadership strategies in a range of game-based settings (GS, RS, S)

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2HP10M10 - Health and Physical Education
substrand_content_descriptions.text: devise, implement and refine strategies for decision-making when working in groups or teams that demonstrate leadership and collaboration skills
substrand_content_descriptions.strand: Movement and Physical Activity – Physical Education

elaborations.name: VC2HP10M10-E01 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: evaluating the contribution they make as an individual to teamwork, leadership and enjoyable participation for all (CA, GS, LLPA, RE, RS)

elaborations.name: VC2HP10M10-E02 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: analysing the use of self-talk and encouragement to motivate themselves and team members to persevere in their participation when things get challenging (CA, GS, LLPA, MH, RE)

elaborations.name: VC2HP10M10-E03 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: creating and implementing self-assessment and peer-assessment tools to evaluate performance in a variety of roles (CA, GS, LLPA, RE)

elaborations.name: VC2HP10M10-E04 - Health and Physical Education
elaborations.elaboration_text: identifying and evaluating leadership styles and group or team dynamics through collaboratively solving initiative games (CA, RS)
